# ssync_mapper_link (Resource)

The mapper_link records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from_id` (String)
- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `type` (Dynamic)

### Optional

- `mapper_id` (String) The mapper the link belongs to, by its key
- `to_id` (String)
- `value_path` (String) Required for a link of type field
- `value_type` (String)
